_comment: A constructed sample, not a real saved response from Indeed's mobile GraphQL endpoint (apis.indeed.com/graphql) — I have no real one to parse against in this environment. Shaped from the jobSearch.results[].job fields JobSpy's Indeed scraper reads (github.com/speedyapply/JobSpy): key, title, sourceEmployerName, location.city/admin1Code, employer.name. Re-save this from a real response before this scraper handles production traffic, per the spec's 'parser tests on saved pages' rule (docs/product/job-finder.md): a schema change should fail this test, not quietly find nothing.
